150001: Introducing Bluebird: the perfect way to add a pop of neon color to your look. This matte nail polish offers a statement-making hue and a luxurious finish that's sure to elevate any nail look. It is part of the neon matte collection which can be purchased here. Bluebird is bright, has a bold matte finish, and is opaque in 2 coats. Use a good base and top (matte) coat to get more durability and longevity from your manicure! **Because matte finishes are more permeable than glossy (they do not have a hard seal), they absorb colors and oils more readily.
